entries.title: Educational Park Art Club
entries.description: \nJoin us every Tuesday as we learn about an artist or art style, then make art of our own.

entries.title: Financial Literacy for Teens
entries.description: Learn about managing credit cards and loans and some strategies you can use to fight back and make your money go further.

entries.title: Reading to Children with Ms. Lee
entries.description: \nParticipating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.

entries.title: Teen Voiceover Challenge
entries.description: TeenHQ’s recording studio wants to hear your best take on “The Birthday Card” Challenge.\nWe all love those hilarious birthday cards we receive or buy from the grocery store, but let’s put a voice to those funny words.

entries.title: Bascom Teens Reach Meeting: Canned Food Drive
entries.description: This program features funnbsp;volunteer opportunities,nbsp;craft activities, games, andnbsp;chances to hang out with your peers and learn new skills and information.To join Teens Reach you must be 13-18 years of age, have a strong interest in the library, enjoy working with people of all ages and cultures, and be willing to learn new skills.

entries.title: Virtual College Application Readiness for High Schoolers
entries.description: A free 45-60 minute talk on college readiness for high school students and their families.nbsp;We'll cover how admissions decisions actually get made, how to build a balanced college list, and application timelines for essays and testing.nbsp;\nFormat is a short presentation followed by open QA.

entries.title: Adaptive Activities Programming at Mount Pleasant Neighborhood Library
entries.description: Join us for socializing, finding new friends and having fun with art,crafts, and games!

entries.title: Indoor Family Storytime
entries.description: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Infant & Toddler Storytime
entries.description: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration.\nThis program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome!

entries.title: Playdates for Children and Their Caregivers
entries.description: Kids get to practice early social skills like sharing, taking turns, imitation of play, and joint attentionnbsp;while caregivers get a chance to connect. \nDon't miss out on this chance to celebrate the joys of play while connecting with other families in the community.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Childrennbsp;program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.nbsp;\nChildren will enjoy a small group interaction with our volunteer and it will be held under the Read to Children sign, within the Children's Area.\nFree.

entries.title: Game On!
entries.description: Our Nintendo Switch console is available for teens to play after school.nbsp; Controllers and games may be checked out at the Information Desk for IN LIBRARY USE ONLY.nbsp;nbsp;For teens 13-18.

entries.title: Lego Engineering
entries.description: Build, learn and imagine with Lego!

entries.title: Safe Routes to School Working Group Meetings for 2026-27
entries.description: Working Group meetings bring together these partners to discuss how to further the program's mission: to make it safer for students and families in Cupertino to get to and from school actively.

entries.title: Ceramic Dish Painting with Arely Cardenas and Local Color
entries.description: Bring your imagination to life with artist Arely Cardenas and Local Color's free ceramic dish painting workshop (for ages 5 and up).

entries.title: Thanksgiving on The Row
entries.description: Explore our restaurants serving holiday specials on Thursday, November 26, and reserve your table: Suspiro – Skip the cooking this Thanksgiving.

entries.title: LEGO Club
entries.description: Students in Kindergarten to 8th grade are welcome to play and create with LEGOs on the first Tuesday of each month.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎幼儿园至 8 年级学生在每月第一个星期二使用 LEGO 积木玩耍和创作。

entries.title: Reading Buddies [Compañeros de Lectura]
entries.description: Come practice your reading skills and read aloud one on one with a furry friend!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每次 15 分钟的阅读活动由一只受过专门训练的治疗犬及其志愿者陪同。Gilroy 图书馆的 Reading Buddies 活动从九月开始，在每月第 1 个星期二举行。

entries.title: Knit & Crochet Circle @ Saratoga Library
entries.description: Bring your own projects and yarn, ask questions, receive help, give help, share ideas, and meet new people!
entries.priorTitleZh: Saratoga 图书馆编织与钩针交流圈
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 带上自己的作品和毛线，提出问题、互相帮助、分享想法并认识新朋友。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Stay and Play
entries.description: Enjoy this socialization for babies and their grownups. 10:30-11:00am Storytime 11:00-12:00pm Stay & Play Thank you to the Los Altos Friends of the Library for making this program possible.

entries.title: Teen Rubik's Cube Club
entries.description: Meet other cubers, learn new techniques, and have fun!

entries.title: Teen Holiday Cookie Decorating Workshop
entries.description: Get creative as you decorate delicious cookies with colorful icing, sprinkles, and festive toppings.

entries.title: Board Game Sunday!
entries.description: Everyone is invited to play board games!

entries.title: Successfully Navigating College Admissions
entries.description: It provides a clear and strategic overview of what students should prioritize at each stage of high school to strengthen their eventual college applications while making the process more manageable and less stressful.
